QuestInfo.name: [Luna Crystal] Dream Blooming Like Flowers
QuestInfo.0: Wisp wants to talk to you. What could it be about??
QuestInfo.1:
Equip all 3 Heroic Lil Flora Pets, then return to Wisp.

#b#e[Heroic Lil Flora Set]#k#n\r\n#e[Pet]#n#i5002674#   #t5002674##i5002675#   #t5002675#\r\n#e#n#i5002676#   #t5002676#
QuestInfo.2: You brought all of the Heroic Lil Flora pets and got a gift from Wisp.

1.msg: Hello, Wisp. How have you been?

2.msg: I have been researching recently. A pet is a doll, but it has life. What, then, is life?

3.msg: While researching, I found out that the Transcendent of Life, #bAlicia#k, left a hidden garden. It was a garden filled with beautiful flowers, almost like a dream.\r#i3801875#

4.msg: The garden was very beautiful, but I think you should have it, #b#h0##k. Something about it suits you.

5.msg: If you bring all the pets of the #e#bHeroic Lil Flora Set#k#n, I'll give you the beautiful garden #i3019175##b #t3019175##k.\r\n#r(This event is a quest that can only be completed once per world.)

yes.0:
Wonderful!
Please keep in mind that you'll have to #requip all 3 Heroic Lil Floras#k.

no.0: It's a pity. I wanted to give you a beautiful garden.

1.0: Okay. Are you ready for my awesome gift?\n\n#b(You cannot receive the gift if you do not have enough space in your Set-up tab.)#k

yes.0: Take this #b#t3019175##k. It's a #bspecial chair you can sit on with the Petite Luna Pets#k. Not only that, but you can #bcommand the Petite Luna Pets and feed them while you're sitting.#k
